{{Top|leg}}
A '''movator''' was a moving walkway in an elevated tube that connected the [[pressure]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. The tubes were constructed of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]. In the event of a breach, [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] shut at both ends and isolated the pressures. Depending on the size, each movator comtained one or two moving walkways with [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] handrails.
